_doc: Engine schema for Cozy Chores "Open House" project "laundry" (GDD 4, 6, 7, 13). Built by cozy-chores-tools/build-projects.mjs from farin-lxd's content-chores-laundry.json; words come from content/laundry.json by line role (a role 'x' in station 's' = the line whose id ends in '.s.x', or the full id). Stand-in art lives in "art" until art/manifest.json lists the real file.

line._doc: The washing line as the learner pegged it: four crew shirts and the pegs in the colours they chose.

objects._doc: farin-lxd 2026-10-29 (lines obj.laundry.*): target words + tr / fa / en glosses.

plate-flat2-wide.name: Flat 2, the chaos
plate-flat2-wide.desc: Ollie’s student flat at number 12: rowing kit everywhere, an oar in the corner, a medal on the door handle, the washing machine in an alcove. Morning light through a big window.

plate-flat2-floor-top.name: The floor, three piles
plate-flat2-floor-top.desc: Straight down on the floorboards: three marked spots for the piles (whites, colours, delicates), the tipped-out laundry in the middle. Morning.

plate-flat2-label-close.name: A shirt’s care label, close
plate-flat2-label-close.desc: Close on the inside of a crew shirt collar: a care label (the symbols are cut-outs, the words are live HTML). Noon.

plate-flat2-machine-close.name: Washing machine, close
plate-flat2-machine-close.desc: The front of an old washing machine: the programme dial (cut-out), the door window. Noon.

plate-flat2-drawer-close.name: Detergent drawer, close
plate-flat2-drawer-close.desc: Close on the detergent bottle and the measuring cap on top of the machine, a 40 ml line printed on the cap (the cap and its level are cut-outs). Noon.

plate-flat2-machine-two.name: Ollie at the machine
plate-flat2-machine-two.desc: Two-shot by the machine, the door about to open; Ollie (cut-out) crouches beside it. Afternoon light.

plate-flat2-phone-close.name: The phone, close
plate-flat2-phone-close.desc: Close on Ollie’s phone on the worktop, a call screen (live HTML), the window bright behind. Afternoon.

plate-flat2-bucket-top.name: Bucket, from above
plate-flat2-bucket-top.desc: Straight down into a metal bucket of water on the kitchen floor (the water and the shirt in it are cut-outs). Afternoon sun on the tiles.

plate-yard-line-wide.name: The yard, the washing line
plate-yard-line-wide.desc: The back yard of number 12 at golden hour: a long washing line across, a peg basket on a chair, a low wall, the harbour light. Brightest frame of the project (CZ8).

co-crew-shirt.name: crew shirt (white)
co-crew-shirt.desc: white rowing shirt with a small printed crest

co-crew-shirt-sock.name: crew shirt (white, a red toe in the sleeve)
co-crew-shirt-sock.desc: the same shirt; a red sock toe peeps out of one sleeve, small but findable

co-heap-pink.name: heap of clothes (the shirts already pink)
co-heap-pink.desc: C1: the shirts tumble out pink, the morning after Ollie washed them with a red sock

co-crew-shirt-pink.name: crew shirt (pink)
co-crew-shirt-pink.desc: the white crew shirt with the same crest, gone an even pink (C1)

co-line-shirt-pink.name: crew shirt on the line (pink)
co-line-shirt-pink.desc: co-line-shirt in the pink of co-crew-shirt-pink (C1, laundry.pinkKept)

co-water-pink-even.name: water (an even, rinsed pink)
co-water-pink-even.desc: C1 pink path: the rinse water, the pink evened out
